response.description: You can use the MCP Toolkit for Azure Cosmos DB, now in general availability, to connect your AI agents and copilots to operational data with enterprise-ready reliability. This release gives you a standardized way to expose Cosmos DB capabilities through Model Context Protocol (MCP), so your teams can build faster, reduce custom integration effort, and scale agent experiences with more confidence. You get a production-focused foundation for secure access patterns, easier tool integration across your AI workflows, and a clearer path from prototype to real-world deployment. Whether you are modernizing existing Cosmos DB applications or launching new agentic solutions, this release helps you deliver data-aware experiences more quickly while maintaining the control and consistency your organization expects.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: MCP Toolkit for Azure Cosmos DB
